attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Professional Counselors and Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 30 Category A (programs by Board-authorized sponsors; automatically approved: ACA, NBCC, AAMFT, NAADAC, IC&RC, other national/international organizations and affiliates, accredited higher-education institutions, state health departments) and max 10 Category B; home study excluded
rules.new_licensee_rule: Renewal period shorter than 2 years: minimum 20 Category A CEUs.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of a percentage of renewals; keep documentation 4 years.

topics.who: All health occupations licensees: one-time attestation of an implicit bias course and (HB 782) a structural racism course

rules.notes: Renewal date is the expiration date in the Board's notice; renewal period = 2 years before it. Approval by another board (e.g. social work) is not automatic approval here. No ethics hour minimum found in COMAR 10.58.05.
